scenario_description:
Objective: Finish producing Cassian’s waterproof sight tape during the indoor-range kiosk session before the workbench shuts down.
Emerging Need: The sight-tape build has been started, but the active kiosk job is paused because one calibration mark is missing and printing is disabled.
Decision Context: Early status only confirms setup; later notices define a short resume window, and the usable value must come from Cassian’s own prior range notes rather than the kiosk.
Consequence: If the missing mark is not available while the job remains open, the saved build is cleared and tonight’s tape cannot be produced.

parameter.title: Indoor range sight tape session
parameter.description: Use the club kiosk to generate a waterproof sight tape after blank stock arrives.

parameter.subject: Sight tape project ST-884 started
parameter.body: A new recurve sight tape project was started on Kiosk 2 at 6:33 p.m. Bow style and 20-yard anchor saved. Print will be available after all calibration anchors pass validation.

parameter.content: Kiosk 2 just paused ST-884 at the 30-yard anchor field. It accepted the 20-yard mark, but the 30-yard value on the worksheet is blank; the printer button stays disabled until that exact mark is entered.

parameter.subject: ST-884 resume window
parameter.body: Project ST-884 remains locked in calibration. Open kiosk jobs are cleared when the workbench closes at 7:00 p.m.; after 6:50 p.m. the laminator queue stops accepting new sight tape prints.

parameter.content: Workbench cleanup started and I moved the blank stock beside Kiosk 2. If the missing 30-yard mark appears before the laminator cutoff, ST-884 can still print; otherwise tonight's stock goes back into the locked cabinet.

parameter.subject: ST-884 cleared without print
parameter.body: Kiosk 2 cleared project ST-884 at 7:00 p.m. because calibration was incomplete. No sight tape was printed, and the blank stock cabinet is locked until the next supervised workbench night.
